milestone.description: The page states, in its own words, what the reader will observe when the quickstart has succeeded.
patterns: you(?:'ll| will| should)(?: now)? (?:see|get|have|receive|be able to)
milestone.capture: the whole line containing the first match, its 1-based line number, and the first fenced code block that begins within the next 3 lines, if any
milestone.scope: the quickstart section (P3) or the full page text (P1/P2)

time_claim.scope: the title, the first H1, or the first 1500 characters of the page text

l1.description: Every package named in an install command exists in its registry.
A version pinned in an install command is at least one MAJOR behind the registry's latest, or the package is marked deprecated (npm) or yanked (PyPI latest).
Every absolute http(s) link in the page (first 25 distinct, excluding the page itself, images, badges, and mailto) answers 2xx or 3xx to a GET under the fetch policy.
An environment variable or command-line tool used inside a code block is never mentioned in prose anywhere on the page.
l1.rule: A tool counts only when it is the first token of a shell code line; an env var counts only when its exact name appears in no prose line.

l1.description: Fenced JavaScript/TypeScript and Python blocks parse (syntax only; nothing is executed). Blocks containing an ellipsis marker (... or the unicode ellipsis) are skipped as intentional fragments.

Before the milestone line (or anywhere, when no milestone exists), the page requires an API key, account, or access token. A stratum attribute (needs-credential), never a defect: it decides L2 eligibility and is reported, and never counts against the L1 pass rate.
l1.pattern: \b(api[ _-]?key|access token|secret key|sign ?up|create an account|log ?in to your account|bearer token)\b

l1_pass_definition: A page passes L1 when it has zero findings in the categories broken-command, version-drift, broken-link, and missing-prerequisite. auth-wall and no-time-claim never count.
headline_template: Of {n} official AI-tool quickstarts snapshotted {date}, {k0} ({p0}%, 95% Wilson CI {lo0}-{hi0}%) state a verifiable first-success milestone; {k1} of those {n0} pass every pre-registered integrity check ({p1}%, CI {lo1}-{hi1}%).

stats.rule: a proportion is never printed without its interval; n is the achieved n, never padded

not_measured: actual learner time-to-success (L2 needs an ephemeral runner and Ryan's approval)
pages that require a browser to render (excluded and counted)
